claims: The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal is part of the 2026 "KPop Demon Hunters" collaboration.
The HUNTR/X Meal features a 10-piece Chicken McNuggets combo.
The HUNTR/X Meal features a medium soft drink.
The HUNTR/X Meal features Ramyeon McShaker Fries with soy-garlic seasoning.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes Demon Sauce.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes Hunter Sauce.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes a collectible photocard.
Ramyeon McShaker Fries are regular fries with a soy, garlic, sesame, and spice seasoning mix to shake in a bag.
Hunter Sauce is a sweet chili sauce with notes of pepper and garlic.
Demon Sauce is a bold, tangy mustard sauce dyed purple.
The HUNTR/X Meal includes a medium drink.
The collectible photocard features members from the film KPop Demon Hunters.
The HUNTR/X meal was released in March 2026.
The HUNTR/X meal was released alongside the "Saja Boys" breakfast meal.
The HUNTR/X meal was released alongside a "Derpy the Tiger" McFlurry featuring berry popping pearls.
The HUNTR/X meal is available for a limited time at participating locations.
The HUNTR/X meal is often ordered via the McDonald's App.
